SHOPENHANCEMENT-REFRESH_COST.title: Refresh Cost
SHOPENHANCEMENT-REFRESH_COST.hover.title: Refresh
SHOPENHANCEMENT-REFRESH_COST.hover.desc:
The Refresh button in the bottom-left of the shop restocks the whole shop: cards, relics, potions, and the card removal slot.
Gift Mode turns off after a refresh.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-RELIC_REFRESH_MODE.title: Relics After Refreshing
SHOPENHANCEMENT-RELIC_REFRESH_MODE.hover:
Vanilla: A relic that has been shown never comes back, even if you didn't buy it. Refresh enough and you run out of relics, leaving only Circlets (after about 40 refreshes).
Rotation: Relics you haven't seen come first. Once you've seen them all, the ones you didn't buy can show up again.
Fully Random: Picks randomly from every relic you haven't bought, so repeats are possible.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-REMOVE_BASE_COST.title: Card Removal Base Price
SHOPENHANCEMENT-REMOVE_BASE_COST.hover.d:
Price = base price + price increase × cards removed so far this run.
Vanilla is 75 + 25 × removals; set these to 75 and 25 for the vanilla experience.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-REMOVE_STEP_COST.title: Card Removal Price Increase
SHOPENHANCEMENT-REMOVE_LIMIT_PER_SHOP.ho: In vanilla you can remove 1 card per shop.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_NO_PURCHASE_REWAR: Get some Gold when you leave a shop without buying anything.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_SKIP_CARD_REWARD_: Get Gold when you skip a card reward. The Skip button shows how much.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_CROSS_CLASS_CARDS:
After you refresh, each character card in the shop may be swapped for another character's card of the same type (Attack for Attack, Skill for Skill).
The shop's initial stock is not affected.
Chance for each character card to be swapped after a refresh. 0.2 means 20%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_SELL_MODE.title: Sell Mode
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_SELL_MODE.hover.d:
Turns on when you enter a shop. Right-click one of your relics or potions to sell it to the merchant; the button in the bottom-left of the shop turns it on or off.
The Sell Prices below are what you get when selling, not what the shop charges.
Anything you bought in a shop never sells for more than you paid.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_PRICE_VARIANCE.hove:
Each item's sell price is randomly nudged up or down from its set price. 0.2 means up to ±20%.
An item's price stays the same no matter how often you check it.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_GIFT_MODE.title: Gift Mode (Multiplayer)
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_GIFT_MODE.hover.d:
In multiplayer, the bottom-left of the shop gets a Gift Mode button and a To button; click To to pick a teammate.
With Gift Mode on, cards, relics, and potions you buy go straight to that teammate, and you pay.
Potions can't be gifted to a teammate whose potion slots are full.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-RELIC_SELL_RULE_PRESET.h:
Pick a preset, or change the switches below (which turns the preset into Custom).
Which group a relic belongs to is decided by the game itself. Not every relic has been tested, so a few may behave unexpectedly.
Strict Mode: Uses the vanilla tradable rule; the switches below are only for reference.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_STARTER_RELICS.hov: The relic your character starts with, such as Burning Blood.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_ANCIENT_RELICS.hov: Relics from the Ancient at the start of each act, such as Golden Compass.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_EVENT_RELICS.title: Event Relics
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_EVENT_RELICS.hover: Relics from events, such as Big Mushroom and Blessed Cheese.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_WAX_RELICS.title: Wax Relics
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_WAX_RELICS.hover.d:
All Wax relics, melted or not.
Turning this off also blocks melted Wax relics.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_MELTED_RELICS.hove:
Lets you block Wax relics that have already melted.
Turning this on also turns on Wax Relics.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_USED_UP_RELICS.hov:
Relics whose uses have run out.
Example: Lizard Tail heals you to 50% HP when you would die, and is used up after that.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_UPON_PICKUP_RELICS:
Relics that do their thing the moment you get them, such as Strawberry (raises Max HP).
Turn this off so players can't take the effect and then sell the relic.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ALLOW_DISABLED_RELICS.ho:
Relics that are currently inactive.
Example: Pumpkin Candle goes out after 5 combats and is relit at a Rest Site.
For reference: Common relics cost about 175 Gold in the vanilla shop. The default buys them back at about 40%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_UNCOMMON_RELIC_PRIC: For reference: Uncommon relics cost about 225 Gold in the vanilla shop. The default buys them back at about 40%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_RARE_RELIC_PRICE.ho: For reference: Rare relics cost about 275 Gold in the vanilla shop. The default buys them back at about 40%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_SHOP_RELIC_PRICE.ho: Relics only sold in shops. For reference: about 200 Gold in vanilla. The default buys them back at about 40%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_ANCIENT_RELIC_PRICE: Vanilla has no price for Ancient relics. Since they're powerful, the default is 40% of 600 Gold.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_STARTER_RELIC_PRICE: Vanilla has no price for Starter relics. Since they matter a lot to your character, the default is 40% of 600 Gold.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_EVENT_RELIC_PRICE.h: Vanilla has no price for Event relics. The default is 40% of 200 Gold.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_RELIC_MIN_GOLD.hove:
After the random variation, a relic always sells for at least this much.
Relics bought in a shop still never sell for more than you paid.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_COMMON_POTION_PRICE: For reference: Common potions cost about 50 Gold in the vanilla shop. The default buys them back at about 40%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_UNCOMMON_POTION_PRI: For reference: Uncommon potions cost about 75 Gold in the vanilla shop. The default buys them back at about 40%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_RARE_POTION_PRICE.h: For reference: Rare potions cost about 100 Gold in the vanilla shop. The default buys them back at about 40%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-SELL_POTION_MIN_GOLD.hov:
After the random variation, a potion always sells for at least this much.
Potions bought in a shop still never sell for more than you paid.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_REMOVAL_ENCHANT_R: Special Services in the Card Removal Slot

From the Nth shop on (see below), each shop has a chance to offer Enchanting or Card Transfer instead of card removal.
With both services on, each is equally likely.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_ENCHANT_SERVICE.h: Pay Gold to enchant cards in your deck. Each shop offers one random enchantment and strength, for a limited number of cards, priced per card.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENCHANT_START_SHOP_VISIT: Shops before this one always offer normal card removal.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENCHANT_REPLACE_CHANCE.h: Chance for each shop to offer a special service instead of card removal. 0.3 means 30%.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENCHANT_COST.title: Price per Enchanted Card
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENCHANT_AMOUNT_MIN.title: Minimum Enchantment Strength
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENCHANT_AMOUNT_MAX.title: Maximum Enchantment Strength
SHOPENHANCEMENT-ENABLE_RANDOM_TEAMMATE_G:
In multiplayer, the shop picks a random teammate and you can pay to give them some cards from your deck. Those cards leave your deck.
Requires Gift Mode to be on.
SHOPENHANCEMENT-GIFT_SERVICE_BASE_COST.h: Price = base price + extra per card × (cards - 1).
